text: The Nexus Teleport Scroll is provided as an objective for Eyes of the Dragon (mage) and Eyes of the Dragon (priest). Using it teleports the character to the Nexus in Borean Tundra.

__NOTOC__ Nexus-Lord Donjon Rade IV is an ethereal added as part of the World of Warcraft: Dragonflight beta, serving to teleport players to the dungeons and raids currently available for testing. He can be found in capital cities.

model.]] riding a nightsaber in Warcraft III.]] Nightsabers are large saber cats found in Kalimdor, commonly used as mounts by the night elves. Considered one of Azeroth's perfect predators, these agile beasts can sprint through dense forests without making a sound. The moon goddess Elune made them silver and black so they could meld into the shadows on a moonlit night. When a night elf's mount perishes, it is custom for the rider to keep one of the saber's great fangs as a token of remembrance. If the reverse occurs and a nightsaber's rider dies, the cat will spend time in mourning and shed tears for their fallen rider. Before they were domesticated by the Sentinel Army and trained as mount

__NOTOC__ Nightlash is a rare banshee found at Valgan's Field in Silverpine Forest. Before the Shattering, she lead the band of Rot Hide gnolls that occupied the Dead Field. She could be found wandering the center of the crop field, surrounded by her gnoll minions. If she was not present, killing her minions would eventually summon her. High Executor Hadrec wanted Nightlash destroyed.

Nightsaber Riders provide fast transportation for Alliance players between fixed points in northern Darkshore. Their role is largely the same as the Rocketway in Azshara for Horde players: shortening travel time for low-level characters without mounts. There are five Nightsaber Riders in total: * Lor'danel: (to Bashal'Aran), (to Ruins of Mathystra) * Bashal'Aran: (to Lor'danel) * Ruins of Mathystra: (to Lor'danel, Shatterspear Vale) * Shatterspear Vale: (to Ruins of Mathystra)

The Nighthold stands as a testament to the achievements of the nightborne civilization. It is the largest structure in the Broken Isles, and among the grandest in all of Azeroth. Centered around the Nightwell, the fount of arcane power that has sustained Suramar for centuries, these grounds were built as a haven from the worries of the world. This is the palace from which Grand Magistrix Elisande runs the city of Suramar. She has brokered a deal with the Burning Legion to allow them to use a portion of the Nightwell energy. The entrance can be found in the Sanctum Depths of the Sanctum of Order. The instance opened January 17, 2017, with Mythic and LFR modes a week later.

.]] Nightborne constructs are mechanical constructs built up by the nightborne and resembling a centauroid with the lower torso of a saber cat. Damaged arcane golems can be seen at the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar, the Ruins of Nar'thalas, and Falanaar, hinting that the development of the nightborne constructs happened under the shield of Suramar City. Automated Sweepers, Pilfered Sweepers, and Scrubbers are smaller versions used for cleaning floors, though larger ones can use brooms. They are good for scavenging high-end parts from. __NOTOC__ Nightborne Rucksack is a quest reward from Court of Stars: Into the Court of Stars.
Nightmare Phantasms are shades that appeared during the attack of Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream on Moonglade. They gained power whenever they killed.

__NOTOC__ Nightborne Eradicator is a nightborne located at Moonfall Approach in Suramar. When the adventurer arrives at Moon Guard Stronghold, it gave Thalrenus Rivertree an opportunity to break free from the battle killing them in the process.
Nightleech is a nerubian flyer located in Skittering Hollow during Island Expeditions.
Nimrida is a succubus and the minion of Keyanomir. She is located with her master in the Murder Row or in the Sanctum of the blood elf capital of Silvermoon City.

Njord's Breath Bay is a large bay south of Kaskala with a medium sized island in the middle found in the Borean Tundra. Even though the Kvaldir are currently invading this area Elder Muahit refuses to leave the altar to Tayutka believing the powerful spirits will aid them if called. The Spirit of Issliruk will hear the cries for help and cause a snow storm which allow the tuskarr to take advantage and kill the Kvaldir leader, Heigarr the Horrible.

Niuzao Temple can be found at the southern end of the big island just off the western coast of Townlong Steppes via a bridge from the Shado-Pan Garrison. The temple for Niuzao, the Black Ox, has been attacked by mantid via the Sra'thik Incursion. To the northeast of the temple is the Fields of Niuzao, and the Niuzao Catacombs are under the temple, accessible via a cave entrance on the western edge of the island. Atop the temple on the same terrace as Commanders Lo Ping and Oxheart, the justice and valor quartermasters, is The Emperor's Burden - Part 5, one of the objectives of The Seven Burdens of Shaohao, a Pandaria exploration achievement.

The Niuzao Catacombs can be found underneath the Niuzao Temple on the big island off the western coast of Townlong Steppes. The catacombs are accessed via a path along the western edge of the island between the temple and the Fields of Niuzao pond. The temple wardens were to keep the Sha of Fear contained, but failed in their task. It has since escaped to the Dread Wastes, infesting the mantid there and riling up the mantid of the Sra'thik Incursion northeast of the temple. The sha left behind Dreadlings, which have killed the Fear-Stricken Sentinels. Deep inside the catacombs is the Ghastly Confines, where the Dread Shadow can be found.

Ninil'ko the Bloodcaller was a Klaxxi paragon, a legend of the mantid who was chosen, as all paragons are, to be encased in amber and preserved for when his strength was needed. Many thousands of years ago, the Klaxxi asked Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver to awaken Ninil'ko, after a mogu relic cut the mantid swarm off from the voice of their empress. Ninil'ko used his exceptional gift for tactics to devise a plan to defeat the mogu, and then used his unique ability to control other mantid warriors to assault the Terrace of Gurthan and capture the relic. North Gate Pass connects Dun Morogh in the high mountains to the west with Loch Modan in the lower mountains to the east. It is frequently traveled by adventurers coming from or going to the Wetlands, as this pass is the closest to the descent from the Loch. North Gate Pass is also the location of the guard station of North Gate Outpost. North Gate Pass.jpg|The pass entrance, Dun Morogh side. North Gate Pass2.jpg|The pass entrance, Loch Modan side.
Nora Baldwin is a human flight master located at Shalewind Canyon in Redridge Mountains.

These are guides for Alliance and Horde players for gathering all Lunar Festival coins from Kalimdor and Eastern Kingdoms. They are designed for players who do not have the Flight Master's License, who will benefit from using flight masters whenever possible.

Norman Powerspark is a gnome located at Lion's Watch in Tanaan Jungle. He is the head engineer at Lion's Watch and oversees the maintenance and construction of vehicles for the Alliance offensive against Gul'dan's Iron Horde. He will help the Alliance player by providing a gnomish flying machine, which allows quick transport to the Throne of Kil'jaeden.
Nol Wildpath is a Highmountain tauren at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Norgannon's Sagacity is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Norgannon.
.]] Northshire River flows from the mountains east of Stormwind City, through Northshire Valley, and eventually empties its waters into Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest.
__NOTOC__ Novia is a blood elf banker located at the Royal Exchange Bank in Silvermoon City.

The Northlands is a name used to refer to different lands in the continent of Lordaeron. The first use of the term was in Warcraft II, referring to much, if not all of the continent of Lordaeron, including the areas around Tyr's Hand, Tyr's Bay, Darrowmere, Caer Darrow, Stromgarde, Lordaeron, and Alterac. The term was later used to refer to only the northernmost lands of the kingdom of Lordaeron itself, where cities such as Stratholme, Andorhal, Hearthglen and Tyr's Hand are located. The archmage Kel'Thuzad owned several warehouses in the region, where he conducted crude necromantic experiments. His experiments ultimately a failure, the Kirin Tor confiscated his property, deeming his efforts

Notes: *This list also includes the proficiency level of Illustrious Grand Master Cooking. *All recipes which are purchased with Epicurean's Award are sold by at A Hero's Welcome (Dalaran), at The Filthy Animal (Dalaran) and at the Argent Tournament Grounds (Icecrown). *All recipes which are purchased with Chef's Award are sold by outside the Stockades (Stormwind City), at the Craftsmen's Terrace (Darnassus), in the Great Forge (Ironforge), in The Drag (Orgrimmar), at the High Rise (Thunder Bluff) and in the Trade Quarter (Undercity).
__NOTOC__ Northwind Hawks are hawks found flying around southern Kun-Lai Summit. Some were seen flying around the Temple of the White Tiger during the Burning Legion's third invasion.
Novice Acolytes are Highmountain tauren located in Feltotem Caverns in Highmountain. They can be seen casting Portals or reading Demonic Tomes.
Novice Warbulls are Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.
Note for Ulan is a memorial note dedicated to Ulan Highmountain found at a shrine in the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain. It was apparently written by Ulan's daughter Mayla.
__NOTOC__ Nutral is the flight master located at the Terrace of Light in the neutral Shattrath City, in Terokkar Forest.

The Oasis of the Fallen Prophet is a subzone of the Lost City of Tol'vir. It is possible to visit this place outside of the instanced Lost City of the Tol'vir, too. It is guarded by Neferset sentries, and its also teeming with crocolisks and wasps.

Oakin Ironbull is a Highmountain tauren of the Rivermane tribe who acts an emissary to the violent Bloodtotem tribe. Torok Bloodtotem calls him "capable, for a Rivermane". Oakin is initially seen at Riverbend when Dargrul uses the Hammer of Khaz'goroth to destroy the village and is among the tauren caught in stone fists who have to be rescued by the player. He later journeys to Cliff's Edge in Bloodtotem territory, vouching for the player so that they will not be killed on sight by the the Bloodtotem warriors. Oakin directs the player to killing the harpies who dwell in the Witchwood in order to prove their worth to Torok, the Bloodtotem chieftain, and accompanies the adventurer to the Cave
Nozcha the Twisted is a Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.
Ny'alotha, the Waking City Guild Run is a raid achievement that is earned for defeating the bosses in Ny'alotha, the Waking City on Normal difficulty or higher while in a guild group.
Obsidian Destroyers are obsidian destroyers found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

The Obsidian Forest is a petrified forest located in the southern coast of the Twilight Highlands. This area was once a Red dragonflight stronghold that was corrupted by the Black dragonflight. In its center stands a large partially petrified tree that was once a beacon of great life. Velastrasza tasked an adventurer to place Alexstrasza's Tear in the hollowed heart of the tree so that in time, the ravaged land would be restored.

The Obsidian Reclaimers are three petrified stone dragons found guarding a batch of black dragon eggs on an upper ledge of Neltharion's Vault in Highmountain. During the flashback in An Ancient Secret, the guardians awaken one by one to defend the eggs from Huln Highmountain and Igrul the Scalebane, as well as the adventurer participating in the vision.

The Obsidian Citadel is located in western Waking Shores, and is the ancient home of the black dragonflight. It is under siege by the Qalashi djaradin under the leadership of Warlord Sargha. Having awoken from their ancient slumber with the return of the dragons, the djaradin laid siege to the Obsidian Citadel only to find it empty; taking it and the internal fortress of Neltharus. The citadel was laid siege to by Wrathion and his Blacktalon forces; despite the Red dragonflight advising against such an assault. Fortunately, the assault was spared massive casualties by the unexpected arrival of Sabellian and the Obsidian Brood; who reinforced Wrathion's assault. The two forces claimed the Obs

The Obsidian Brood refers to the group of black dragons that were shepherded and cared for by Sabellian on Outland. Having been originally placed on Draenor by Deathwing, the clutch was abandoned after the mad aspect's plans went awry and the planet later exploded. Having bent Blade's Edge to their will, the Obsidian Brood returned to Azeroth upon the re-awakening of the Dragon Isles. They supported the endeavors of their leader to become the next Aspect of the black dragonflight. With Sabellian's withdrawal from Aspect, however, they still serve him as their general under his brother and new Aspect, Ebyssian. By unknown means, they have been purged of their Old God corruption, and have also

Ogres are large, brutish humanoids of notable strength native to Draenor, which they refer to as Dawgar ("the Known Earth" in their native language). Descendants of the various stone giants known as Breakers, the ogres were originally enslaved by their progenitors, the ogron. Eventually, the ogre hero Gog the Gronnslayer showed that it was possible to kill the gronn, which both ogres and ogron revered as godlike beings, and he became the founder of the Gorian Empire that would come to rule much of Draenor for centuries until the arrival of the draenei. Over the years, ogre influence gradually waned across the world as they were slowly surpassed by their orc descendants and the draenei as the

Occulus is a rare drake found in Tanaris. He was once part of the bronze dragonflight, guarding the entrance to the Caverns of Time, but has since been corrupted by the infinite dragonflight; exactly how is unclear.
__NOTOC__ Officer Dawning was a blood elf quest giver located outside the bank in The Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

The Oculus is a 5-man wing of the Nexus in Coldarra (a subregion of Borean Tundra in Northrend) designed for level 80 players. The Oculus is a tower of "magical rings" that float above the ground and the first instance to allow players the use of certain flying mounts. The gate of the oculus is located directly above the nexus gate, requiring the rampway to reach.

Of Trapes and Lockes is an archaic book on the nature of securing devices. Khadgar studied this tome during his stay at Karazhan in order to safely open many of Medivh's books that had been locked using differing strengths of magic.

Off-Duty Bruiser is a goblin found in the Orgrimmar Embassy of Orgrimmar, standing next to a Leyline Navigator, Wildswalker Nightborne, and Highmountain Brave. While technically off-duty, the bruisers still give players' directions like any city guard. Originally, more of them were present in the Goblin Slums and were seen relaxing and interacting with Off-Duty Siegeworkers and Off-Duty Grunts.

The Ogre-Magi were originally a small band of extremely loyal Ogre enforcers, transformed by Gul'dan into scheming and malicious sorcerers. By warping and twisting the Elf-magiks of the Runestone at Caer Darrow, Gul'dan was able to infuse the magical abilities of long dead Warlocks into the bodies of these unsuspecting hosts. Once hulking simpletons, the transformed Ogre-Magi can direct their death magiks as easily as their lesser cousins would deliver a crushing blow to any foolish enough to stand in their path. The Ogre-Magi have also become extremely cunning and insidious - serving the Horde only as they see fit.

__NOTOC__ Officer Lianin is a blood elf located in the Town Hall of Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. Lianin is one of several recruiting officers available to the hero. He offers the opportunity to exchange the default orc guards for Silvermoon City blood elves. He is only available to players after constructing a level 3 Barracks.
Odan Battlebow is a dwarf flight master located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Officer Fairbanks is a human officer in the Stormwind City Guard who can be found patrolling the streets of the Lion's Rest and the Canals in Stormwind City. He carries two swords.
Odaug is a Highmountain tauren who poisoned the waterways of Highmountain.
Ogrezonia is a tiny island filled with giant female ogres that are rumored to perform horrible rituals to men who happen upon their isle. A ship from Azeroth Express crashed on the island.

Ogre Mine is a sub-zone in Molten Quarry in southeastern Ashran, alternate Draenor. The mine features a sizeable population of mobs, including goren and a large number of the neutral Power Geodes. At the far end of the mine a large and very powerful rare mob can be found.
Okano the Ferris is a Highmountain tauren repair vendor found at the Felbane Camp in Highmountain.

The Ohn'ahran Plains are a verdant grassland zone on the Dragon Isles, inhabited by the green dragonflight and the Maruuk Centaur. It is the second zone that players venture through, after the Waking Shores. The region is named for the eagle Wild God Ohn'ahra, who long ago guided Maruuk and Teera centaur to the Dragon Isles. The centaur initially warred with the green flight, but after realizing that they were evenly matched, the two races agreed to share the region, with the green dragons inhabiting the groves while the centaur dominated the plains. However, as the dragons left the isles after the Great Sundering, the centaur have been left to develop their culture in isolation for ten thou
__NOTOC__ Olirea is a blood elf fishing vendor located in Walk of Elders in Silvermoon City.
__NOTOC__ Oloraak is an arakkoa fish vendor located in the Lower City of Shattrath City.

Old Stratholme (Stratholme City in the map and referred to as Stratholme Past) is the setting of the Culling of Stratholme instance, alongside the Road to Stratholme. It is also one of the areas visited in The Deaths of Chromie. The instance is set four years before the beginning of World of Warcraft around the time of the Warcraft III campaign mission The Culling, during in which Prince Arthas leads the purge of Stratholme. The forested region outside Stratholme, and some of the city areas like King's Square or the Festival Lane are fully explorable, provided that you have not spoken to Arthas after using the to locate the plagued grain.

Old Hook-eye is a Highmountain tauren fishmonger found on the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Old Kud is a Highmountain tauren food vendor found on the Snowblind Mesa in Highmountain.

__NOTOC__ Old Fillmaff is an undead located in the Hall of the Guardian. He served Dalaran for several decades until the death knight Arthas Menethil attacked the city during the Third War. Fillmaff went missing and reappeared years later, when Dalaran was teleported above Northrend. He immediately started organizing books. Rumors have it that he doesn't know he is dead.

__NOTOC__ Omi is a vulpera quest giver located on the western outskirts of the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun alongside Kenzou and Tacha. She "can't spit dust" when it comes to magic, but claims to be able to mix poisons and potions with the best of them. It's her job to scout out the ruins to identify threats and figure out the best way in for the scavenger crew. When an adventurer arrives at the Court of Zak'rajan, Omi asks them to gather stomachs from the local ranishu. She then informs them that the majority of the valuable weaponry in the Court of Zak'rajan is stored in two storehouses guarded by two powerful specters, and asks them to kill the spirits so she can ransack the supplies. Old Li Needs Help! is a bonus objective on Island Expeditions. Its objective differs depending on the island.

__NOTOC__ Oninath is a blood elf hunter trainer located in the Rangers' Lodge in Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony.
Ontok Shatterhorn is the Season 4 Arena rewards vendor. He resides in a tent in Lower City. He also sells epic quality gems for 800 arena points apiece.
"On the Virtues of Magic" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
Onyx Flight Captains are black dragonspawn captains of the black dragonflight, located in the Obsidian Sanctum.
One of Us! One of Us! is a quest achievement earned by gaining Power Overwhelming while inside the realm of the void in the Shadowmoon Enclave.

One-Eye is an old one-eyed wyvern. She was held captive by the Gordunni clan in Dire Maul along with three of her cubs under a dome of thorns. When the ogres' slaves refused to fight, she was sent do deal with them. This happened when Aramar Thorne refused to kill the gnoll Hackle. The two combatants took advantage of her being one-eyed and coordinated their attacks. When Aram hoped on her, he noticed a thorn collar which he removed, but she didn't fly away, yet she stopped attacking the younglings. When the Hidden attacked Dire Maul and killed a guard named Arkus, his head was sent flying, landed next to her and she raised it with her tail and showed it to King Gordok. The druid Thalyss Gre

Onyx Annulet is a quest reward from The Forgotten Ring, part of the Zskera Vaults storyline in the Forbidden Reach. Much like the Pocket-Sized Computation Device from Mechagon Island, players will acquire Primordial stones that they can use to socket into the ring. According to Researcher Imareth, the annulet was designed by Neltharion himself, and intended to empower his most elite and loyal scalecommanders... yet none were found worthy, and thus, the rings were left in the depths of his vaults. The orcs are a prolific and physically powerful race hailing from the once-lush world of Draenor, now known as the shattered realm of Outland. Originally a shamanistic people cultivating a primitive clan-based society, the orcs were corrupted by Kil'jaeden—a demon lord of the Burning Legion—and manipulated into forming a bloodthirsty Horde that waged war on the peaceful draenei race. Rampant demonic corruption caused the orc

Oran Snakewrithe is a Forsaken located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. Apparently, she is "a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls". Before the Cataclysm she was located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Or'kaos the Insane is a nether drakonid patrolling a floating island on the southeastern edge of Netherwing Ledge in Shadowmoon Valley.
The Opportunist's Leather Tunic is a reputation reward; you must be Honored with Lower City to purchase it for from in Shattrath City.
Optical Blast is an Observer ability. It is the equivalent of the Felhunter's Spell Lock ability.

Orastrasz was a red dragon charged with guarding the Dragon Soul in a hidden location guarded by wards and buried deep beneath the Redridge Mountains. Deathwing, who intended for the Orcish Horde to gain control of the Dragon Soul, subtly coaxed Zuluhed the Whacked and his Dragonmaw clan to Orastrasz' location, at which point the orcs immediately fell upon the guardian. They had never faced a red dragon in battle before, and over a dozen orcs perished before they succeeded in killing Orastrasz. Zuluhed ordered the Dragonmaw's greatest warlock, Nekros Skullcrusher, to recover the artifact. The orc shattered the relic's defenses and renamed it the "Demon Soul" due to the faint fel energies lin

The Orb of Sciallax was a powerful artifact that during the War of the Ancients the demon lord Sciallax offered to the night elves of Suramar in exchange for their servitude to the Burning Legion. Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher of the Reliquary knew about the orb from his studies about the War of the Ancients, so he traveled to Suramar to find it during the Legion's third invasion. He had adventurers to find Highborne texts and discover the orb's exact whereabouts. Tae'thelan and the adventurers then set goblin explosives in Kel'balor where the orb was located. The explosives did not break the orb free, instead they destroyed it, leaving only fragments of it. Some fragments were taken by the advent

.]] Orgrimmar Grunts are max level orc guards located throughout the capital city of Orgrimmar as well as in the nearest parts of Durotar and Azshara. They can provide directions to various locations in the city.

Orebor Harborage is an Alliance village in northern Zangarmarsh. It is comprised mostly of Kurenai, a faction of Broken who seek to reestablish their ties with the uncorrupted Draenei. Orebor has a flight path and vendors selling armor and cooking supplies, as well as various NPCs who offer quests, mainly for gaining reputation with the Kurenai. The town also allows access to the Blade's Edge Mountains to the north.

Oric Coe is Adam Eternum's gnomish sidekick found in the Lower City of Shattrath City. He and Adam returned to the Arathi Highlands and participated in the Battle for Stromgarde alongside the League of Arathor fighting against the Horde from Ar'gorok.

Orgrimmar Battle Standard (also referred to as the Battle Standard of Durotar) is a large battle standard with the new insignia of Orgrimmar on it. Forged by Rexxar's strength and courage, the Battle Standard of Orgrimmar can inspire armies to fight with an insatiable thirst for blood, giving them strength and vitality when other armies would fall.

Orc Commoners are orcs found in Orgrimmar. Several of them gathered in front of Valley of Strength's original bank when the Forsaken Refugees entered the city following the betrayal of Putress and Varimathras. They appear in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Orc Refugees can be found in at the Refugee Caravan in Terokkar Forest waiting to begin moving along again and also living in the Lower City of Shattrath City.

.]] The Orgrimmar Tunnels are a series of tunnels that run underground Durotar, starting outside of the orc city of Orgrimmar. Gazlowe and his goblins dug them out in search of a reliable water supply for the Horde's new city. However, they mined directly to a kobold den, which put a halt to the operation. The kobolds were later routed by Rexxar and his companions, and the breaches into the dens were closed off, after which Gazlowe and his employees could finish their task. Rexxar also encountered an isolated group of wildkin within the earthen passageways.

The Ordon Sanctuary is the home of Ordos, the yaungol demigod of fire. Found on a rise high above the rest of the Timeless Isle, the sanctuary was originally accessed by the last bridge span of the Firewalkers' Path. Since the bridge has been destroyed, other means of gaining access to the area are required, such as: *Running to the edge of the bridge with Wrathion's legendary cloak equipped *Getting snagged by a Highwind Albatross and killing it while over the sanctuary *Using the Gleaming Crane Statue's high jump and slow fall to make it across the broken bridge *Purchasing a Golden Glider, swimming to out-of-bounds (where you get fatigued), flying high enough and then towards Ordon Santua
Orgrimmar Sea Dogs are orcs found in Blasted Lands. Most of them are fighting with Ironmarch Grunts on Shattershore and one is found at Shattered Landing.

Orgrimmar Aerial Sentries are flying shredders located in Orgrimmar during the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar. Flying in Orgrimmar causes them to target the adventurer. Applying five stacks of the Locked On debuff dismounts.

Osborne the Night Man is a human rogue trainer located outside the SI:7 headquarters in Old Town in Stormwind City. When the city was under the lockdown due to the infiltration from the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned, Osborne guarded the entrance into the SI:7 building alongside Renzik "The Shiv".

__NOTOC__ Orphan Matron Battlewail is an orc quest giver located in The Drag in Orgrimmar. She lives and works at the city's orphanage with Tosamina. She and her friend watch over the orc children who've lost their parents in war. Before the restructuring of the city, the orphanage was located in the Valley of Honor. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, Battlewail and Tosamina were keeping the orphans safe within the orphanage and the door locked tight. They were ready to fight anyone that attempted to enter. She appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.

Ortell's Hideout is a small cave located in southeastern Silithus where Hermit Ortell resides. After Sargeras destroyed Silithus, the cave's entrance vanished. It was likely buried by an avalanche, as the mountains around the border of the zone shifted.

__NOTOC__ Osselan is a blood elf paladin trainer located in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, Osselan joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, he is no longer a member of the Silver Hand. He was present in the Court of the Sun during the closing of the remembrance ceremony. After the death of Vorath, Osselan was among the gathered paladins outside the Hall of Blood in Farstriders' Square to congratulate the sin'dorei hero for their victory in Deatholme.
Orok Deathbane was a level 5 quest giver located in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. He was only available during the Love is in the Air seasonal event.

Oronok's Farm is a simple boar-farming camp and home to Oronok Torn-heart, a neutral orc quest giver. It is found at the top of the mountain northeast of Coilskar Point in northern Shadowmoon Valley. The pigs here are called Domesticated Felboars.
Ornamm is a tauren from the Highmountain tribe that tried to kill the undead tauren Trag Highmountain.

Orsis is a tol'vir city located in west-central Uldum. When the tol'vir were afflicted by the Curse of Flesh, as many creations of the Titans were, they were offered to swear allegiance to the evil dragon Deathwing in order to regain their stone skin. But the people of Orsis refused... and so Deathwing's ally, the Elemental Lord Al'Akir, buried Orsis beneath the sands in a great windstorm as punishment and to serve as a warning to the other tribes. King Phaoris of Ramkahen, who leads the tol'vir who oppose Deathwing and Al'Akir, sends any adventurers who are willing to give aid to the survivors of Orsis, buried beneath the choking sands. Powerful air elementals, minions of the Windlord, also

The Orsis tribe is a group of tol'vir that controls the territory of western Uldum. They lived in peace with the other tol'vir tribes for a long time, until the Neferset tribe allied themselves with Deathwing and the elemental lord Al'Akir. When the Orsis were given the same choice, they refused and as punishment were buried, along with their city, by a massive sandstorm. Many members of the tribe were killed, though some were saved or lucky enough to not be in the city at the time. Prince Nadun offered the survivors refuge in Ramkahen.
Orna Skywatcher is a tauren flight master located at Cliffwalker Post in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Otto von Chubbs is the pug pet of Dylan Aguilar; they can be found playing in the Stormwind City Outskirts, near a house at the southwest of the island with the portals. Like Dylan, he's hostile to Horde players but cannot be attacked.

Orovinn was a dealer of mana crystals, items which many blood elves were using to keep their addiction to magic in check. He operated out of the shady confines of Murder Row, and found a frequent patron in the former priest Galell, who was hopelessly addicted to arcane magic and very reliant on his crystals. Orovinn was murdered and hanged from the Shepherd's Gate by an increasingly unstable Galell.

Oro Junior is the younger son of Warbrave Oro and his wife Kura, found at Oro's Overlook in Highmountain. Most of the time he runs around the overlook with a fishing pole in hand, which annoys his older brother Mycah as he's scaring most of the fish away from the nearby river. Other times, Oro Junior can be found sleeping next to the main hut of the overlook. According to Mycah, Oro is a lot for Kura to handle on her own since the two brothers' father is off to battle. During Assaults on Highmountain, the Stonehoof family retreat into their hut, with Kura and Mycah defending the entrance while Oro Junior stays behind them.
Ossirat is an obsidian destroyer located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

the entrance to Outland Arena.]] The Outland Arena is an arena in Outland reached through a Shimmering Portal in Dustwallow Marsh. It is a mound of earth surrounded by cages housing powerful demonic entities. In it, Rexxar, Cairne Bloodhoof, Rokhan and Chen Stormstout fought Destroyer Zardikar, Talnivarr the Sleeper and Sinstralis of the Pain to get tomes and coins.

Owls are broad-faced, nocturnal birds known to hunt rodents and reptiles. They look different from most birds in that they have wide faces, short curved beaks, and large, front-facing eyes. Owls are found throughout Teldrassil, Felwood, and Winterspring. In Alterac Valley, the Alliance has befriended the owls. Owls with dark feathers have been found native to Outland, living in Shadowmoon Valley, but nowhere else. However, the similar-looking windrocs and kaliri do appear in other areas. They are a symbol of the human region of Tol Barad and are used by the Stormpike clan of dwarves. The owl is also a common emblem of the night elves, and priestesses of the moon and huntresses have the abili

Owl Wing Thicket is a series of caves in southern Winterspring. They host a large number of berserk, moontouched, and crazed owlbeasts. It is here that the ancient Guardians of Elune tell how the moonkin came into the world (in a quest chain exclusive to the Alliance), guided by Ranshalla.
__NOTOC__ :"The Kor'kron guard would be honored to fight by your side anytime." Overlord Or'barokh is an orc quest giver located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Overseer Ripsaw is a mo'arg found at Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley. He is notable for dropping a quest item, Illidari-Bane Shard, which starts a long quest chain to receive a weapon with powerful bonuses against demons.
Owlkin Frenzy was a passive specialization ability for Balance druids, available at level 48. It greatly increased the potential of the druid's Moonkin Form.
P.B.I.T. is sold by Nick Arse located in front of the Cauldron of Rock cave on the Darkmoon Island.
Owlbeast Blood drops from Moonlost Owlbeasts and Mooncrazed Owlbeast in Val'sharah.
Pack Mules are mules found at Odesyus' Landing of Azuremyst Isle, also in the Eastern Plaguelands, and Darkmoon Island.

Malfurion Stormrage himself had experimented with the form long ago and, consumed by its rage, went as far as blindly attacking his mentor, Cenarius. The paladin (often shortened to "pala" or "pally" by players) is a holy knight, a hybrid class with the ability to play a variety of different roles — healing (holy), tanking (protection), and DPS (retribution). Firstly introduced in Warcraft II, then as hero units in Warcraft III and a character class of World of Warcraft, the paladins stand directly in front of their enemies, relying on heavy armor and healing in order to survive incoming attacks. Whether with massive shields or crushing two-handed weapons, Paladins are able to keep claws and swords from their weaker fellows – or they use healing magic to ensure that they remain on their feet. Stalwart paladins are trained to use the heavi

A paladin trainer is an NPC that offers paladins the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points. A general rule-of-thumb for finding the local Paladin trainer is to search the city's centre of religious worship, where they can usually be found alongside Priest trainers.

The word panic button refers to the phenomenon that every class in the game has some sort of a button they press in order to save their hides from a certain death. Some classes are more 'blessed' with these buttons than others but it is usually evened out by their surviving/damaging skills. Panic buttons are nearly always instant spells with a certain cooldown, to make them available for use at all times, but not limitlessly. These abilities are usually neither Crowd Control methods nor Snares, though the Druid's Nature's Grasp is useful as a Crowd Control method and some of the other abilities have other offensive uses.
Pale Moon Cloak is a quality Cloak which improves Strength, Stamina, Critical Strike and Shadow Resistance.
__NOTOC__ Pricilla Winterwind is a night elf flight master located at Stars' Rest in the Dragonblight.

Pandemic was a passive warlock ability, available at level 90. The ability was removed when patch 6.0.2 turned it into a baseline mechanic for all classes for both damage and healing periodic effects (though reduced to a maximum of 30% the base duration). Though this mechanic is not officially named, it is still sometimes referred to as the "pandemic effect."

:The elements of Pandaria can be cute and playful, until their homeland is threatened. Pandaren spirits, or ancient spirits, are elementals that exist on Pandaria and the Wandering Isle, representing the heart of its elemental powers. Most of them protect their element in various locations and have done so for thousands of years. Hostile spirits also exist on various islands hiding and waiting to playfully attack adventurers. Though fire spirits appear to be a vaguely-related cousin to the Cinder Kitten, the two creatures actually share no ancestry. The playful water spirits have a curious connection to the weather. They are especially mischievous, and are known to frequent the canals of the

Pale orcs, also called the Pale, are deformed, sickly orcs afflicted with unnaturally pale skin and glowing eyes as a result of Void corruption. They were once found on the main universe's Draenor, where Cho'gall recruited them into the Horde to form the Old God-worshipping Twilight's Hammer clan. Many Pale orcs still plague the alternate Draenor. The Pale are wretched creatures who hate the Light and despise all that is good and holy, hiding beneath the ground and plotting against the innocent and those who dwell on the surface. Dangerous and disturbing, the pale orcs are little more than husks of barely living flesh bent by dark magics. They are expert scavengers and are known to eat their

Palewind Totems are totems that were used by the Palewind tribe at Hatred's Vice before they were destroyed by the Sha of Hatred. They were used to store great amounts of magical energy. Yalia Sagewhisper used them to draw forth the sha at Hatred's Vice.
Palace Minders are flying tomes found in the Menagerie and Midnight Court in the city of Suramar.

Paku'ai Noshata was a Zandalari troll formerly located at the top of the palace in Dazar'alor near Rastakhan during the beta. He was removed before the expansion's release as the flight path had been moved down to the lower floor and the flight master had been changed.
The Paku'ai are Zandalari troll flight masters. The name seems to reference the loa Pa'ku in connection with the flying service with the pterrordax they provide.

__NOTOC__ Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a tauren quest giver located at Highperch in the Thousand Needles. To find him, look for the large tauren totempole. There is a small path leading up the mountainside behind it. Years after finding his way to freedom after being trapped in Highperch while trying to study the native wind riders, Pao'ka resolved to return and protect them. When the Cataclysm struck, he sought to defend the creatures from capture or destruction by the Twilight’s Hammer.
__NOTOC__ Parnis is a blood elf trade goods vendor located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
__NOTOC__ Parshah is a arakkoa quest giver located on the road south from Shadowmoon Village through the Magma Fields in Shadowmoon Valley. He was a member of the Dark Conclave, but he deserted.

Parts Recovery Technicians are part of the pre-XT-002 Deconstructor trash. They place down a moderately large yellow shield. Robots within the shield are given a buff which will regenerate their health very quickly. Move all mobs out of the shields as they are placed down. Recovery Technicians are the most dangerous mobs. Destroy these first.
Parek Splitfeather is a Highmountain tauren stable master found at Skyhorn in Highmountain.

.]] The panthara are cat-like beasts from Argus. They have scales covered in mana-sensitive particulate. They are solitary creatures and devour energy to survive. Energetic apex hunters of Argus, the panthara hunt by sensing the energy within living things. A panthara approaching a powerful energy source will visibly change color and become more excited. They change color based on mood. The Luminous Starseeker demonstrates the ability to grow feathery wings, but no other panthara have been seen doing this.
Patch 10.2.0: Guardians of the Dream is the second content patch of Dragonflight. It was released on November 7, 2023. It's the last major patch of Dragonflight.
The Path of Conquest is a long road that switchbacks through the mountains in southern Shadowmoon Valley. It is heavily entrenched by blood elves and colossi in service to Illidan.
Path of Water is a small tunnel carved into the mountain of Thunder Totem leading to the Hall of Chieftains in Highmountain. It is the entrance of the Rivermane tribe.
Path of Sky is a small tunnel carved into the mountain of Thunder Totem leading to the Hall of Chieftains in Highmountain. It is the entrance of the Skyhorn tribe.
Pathfinder Petehsu is a Highmountain tauren druid in Bear Form sleeping next to a hut at the Summitcrest Basecamp in Highmountain.
Patri Burkhorn is a Highmountain tauren innkeeper found at Stonehoof Watch in Highmountain.
Pathfinder Linny is a Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.
Patchwork Terrors were abominations attacking the Undercity and Stormwind City.

Patch 9.1.5 is the second medium patch of Shadowlands, officially announced via a blue post on August 19, 2021. It added additional customization options for Highmountain tauren, Lightforged draenei, nightborne and void elves, new travel forms for druids, new soulshapes for the Night Fae Covenant, new toys, Legion Timewaking including Mage Tower challenges and solo Island Expeditions. It released on November 2, 2021. It was pushed to the Public Test Realm on September 3, 2021.

World of Warcraft: Pearl of Pandaria is an original graphic novel set in the Warcraft universe, and ties into the 4th expansion pack, World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. It is set before the Cataclysm and gives a look at Pandaria before the mists protecting the island were cleared. The plot of the comic revolves around Chen Stormstout's niece, Li Li, as she ventures into the world with another pandaren named Bo, who wishes to take her back home to the Wandering Isle.

Perfect Performance is an achievement earned from participating in a perfect performance of the Blight Boar concert on Darkmoon Island. At least 4 people need to be present and have all 4 unique buffs for anyone to receive the achievement: *Drummer-Avoid all Banshee Walls, stand in all Bolts of Light. *Bassist-Avoid all Banshee Walls, miss at least 1 Bolt of Light. *Guitarist-Hit by at least 2 Banshee Walls, miss 2 Bolts of Light. *Vocalist-Hit by at least 2 Banshee Walls, stand in all Bolts of Light.
Pendrake's Shattered Aegis is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

When the player acquires a controllable pet, a Pet Action Bar appears on screen. While every pet has unique abilities, there are 6 commands that are universal to all pets. These commands are not class specific and are listed in the window below. The / commands for some pet actions are as follows: /petattack /petfollow /petmoveto /petassist /petdefensive /petpassive Other more specific pet abilities, such as a Spider pet's Web can be input simply as /cast Web.
__NOTOC__ Periel is a blood elf banker located at the Royal Exchange Bank in Silvermoon City.

Pet families are a system of classification for hunter pets. A pet's family, which is generally based on its species, dictates what food it can eat; what abilities it will have; and what requirements, if any, a hunter needs to meet in order to tame it. In Dragonflight, there are 60 pet families. In Classic Wrath, there are 32 pet families. In Classic, there are 17 pet families.

The Pet Battle System allows players to use their companion pets in turn-based mini-games to capture wild pets to add to their collection, battle NPC Pet tamers, and test their skills against other players. Winning a battle rewards the participating pets with experience, which allows pets to gain levels, increasing their power and unlocking new abilities to use in battles. To participate in pet battles, players must learn the Battle Pet Training skill from a Battle Pet Trainer, available at level 5 for . __NOTOC__ Petey Yar was a human who was located outside the Magical Menagerie in Dalaran during the patch 7.2 PTR. He allowed players to test flying on the Broken Isles. He was removed during a later stage of the PTR.
Perfidious Dreadlords were nathrezim located in the Undercity during the Battle for the Undercity. They were fought by the Alliance and Horde.

__NOTOC__ Perrin Moontear is a night elf located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City, replacing Nayura. With The Bravery being out of commission since the Burning of Teldrassil, she maintains a mage portal to Darkshore to replace it.
Ph'el Oman is a Lightforged draenei warlock who first appears as Initiate Oman on Darkmoon Island.
Phase Shift makes the Imp invulnerable to all hostile and beneficial abilities, with the exception of Soul Link and Health Funnel.

Philia Fintallas is the daughter of Parqual Fintallas and Mina who lived in their modest but comfortable chambers in Capital City. Since the Third War she has been living in Stormwind City. She is described as having large, expressive eyes and a small button nose.
Phenomenal Cosmic Power is a feat of strength achievement earned by infusing the Heart of Azeroth with all available Essences from the Rise of Azshara update for any role at rank 4.

The Pillars of Aszune are a series of arches named after Aszune on the Broken Isles that lead to the open ocean. They are seen at the end of the "Wrath of the Betrayer" mission. Their name is only mentioned in the quest text of the second main quest of the mission, "Escape to the Sea". A Circle of Power labeled as "Runner Destination" lies under them, which is the location that the transport ship carrying the Night Elf Runner had to get to.
The Pitch Dark Post is a shop in the Evermoon Bazaar of Suramar City in Suramar. It is run by a Timid Shopkeeper.

Plagued dragons refer to dragons that have been infused with the Plague of Undeath by the Cult of the Damned. The experiment began within Scholomance as another method of spreading the plague. The necromancers of Scholomance, working under Vectus, used black dragon eggs from the Burning Steppes as the basis for their experiments, and hoped to unleash the plagued dragons on the world as a dragonflight. However, the Argent Dawn caught wind of their activities and worked to destroy the abominable plagued dragons before they could be deployed. Plainsrunning was an ability that was only available to tauren players. Originally, the tauren did not have a mount, so when a tauren player reached level 40, they spoke to Saern Priderunner on the Hunter Rise of Thunder Bluff who also provided the quest Plainsrunning (quest) or Samantha Swifthoof in Stranglethorn Vale. The Plainsrunning ability itself was an aura with similar limitations to the mounts, but operated slightly differently. Plainsrunning was removed before the game went live and kodos became the tauren racial mounts. Plaguewood Tower is a scout tower located in the Plaguewood of the Eastern Plaguelands, very close to the nearby Terrordale. During the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron, the tower was probably destroyed and left in ruins. It later became a battleground as it was one of the fallen towers that the Alliance and Horde fought over in order to fortify themselves in the region. After the Cataclysm, Plaguewood Tower, along with all the other towers of the Eastern Plaguelands, have since been rebuilt by the Argent Crusade and is being used as an outpost in the region. Like Light's Hope Chapel, there are signs of life around the tower, and there is also a neutral flight master. __NOTOC__

Plagued Felbeasts were darkhounds located in the Undercity during the Battle for the Undercity.

The Plague Eater is a slime giant following Master Apothecary Faranell in Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Once it is empowered with the concoctions of the House of Plagues and the Lordaeron Blight in Maldraxxus, it is replicated and more are deployed by Forsaken Soldiers in the Ruins of Lordaeron. They then merged into the Amalgam. Once it was destroyed, and the Forsaken entered Lordaeron, the original Plague Eater came with them.
